name: Tome of the Cabal
summary: Above Ratchet, Strahad Farsan sends an aspiring Alliance warlock to the Library of Ironforge. A felhunter’s hunger can overwhelm an unprepared summoner, and the Tome of the Cabal holds the knowledge needed to summon and bind the demon.

sections.title: A Beast That Feeds on Magic
sections.body: An imp, a voidwalker, or a succubus can be subdued through ritual, but a felhunter brings a different hazard. Felhunters serve the Burning Legion and hunt down arcane energy to devour it. A standard summoning circle will crumble before one, draining the summoner’s magic before a binding can take hold. From his redoubt in the Barrens, Strahad Farsan watches over Ratchet and knows an amateur must not attempt the binding unprepared.

sections.title: The First Binding
sections.body: An acolyte needs the arcane formulas in the Tome of the Cabal to draw forth and bind a felhunter safely. The earliest mortal cabal of warlocks who successfully broke a felhunter without outside aid authored the manuscript. Its pages detail the geomancy, materials, and binding runes needed to withstand the creature’s hunger. The copy was lost long ago, leaving Strahad and his circle without the masterwork.

sections.title: The Hoarder of Dun Morogh
sections.body: Strahad sends Alliance warlocks across the Great Sea to the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge, since he cannot provide the text himself. Krom Stoutarm, an itinerant dwarven warlock, resides there and spends his twilight years combing through ancient manuscripts and library records. If any trace of the lost grimoire remains recorded in the Eastern Kingdoms, it rests buried in Krom’s meticulous catalogs.

faq.q: Why do I need to find the Tome of the Cabal?
faq.answer: The Tome of the Cabal holds precise instructions from the first mortal warlocks who summoned and subdued a felhunter without outside aid. Ordinary summoning rituals cannot entrap a demon that actively feeds on magical energy.
Krom Stoutarm is a wandering dwarven warlock who resides in the Library of the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. He spends his days holed up among dusty tomes, cataloguing ancient historical records.

faq.q: Why is Strahad Farsan in the Barrens?
faq.answer: Strahad Farsan is an accomplished human warlock with a quiet, neutral redoubt on the bluffs above Ratchet. Outside the watchful eyes of the Kirin Tor and Stormwind’s authorities, he trains both Alliance and Horde practitioners in powerful demonology.

faq.q: What happens after I speak to Krom Stoutarm?
faq.answer: Krom Stoutarm recalls references to the tome in old cataloguing registers. He charges you with tracking down its lost parts and recovering the rare reagents needed to reconstruct the grimoire.

faq.q: Can Horde warlocks do this quest?
faq.answer: This journey to Ironforge is for Alliance warlocks. Strahad gives Horde warlocks an equivalent task, sending them to find knowledgeable contacts within Horde territory.

faq.q: What demon does this questline unlock?
faq.answer: Completing the Tome of the Cabal chain brings ritual combat against a summoned felhunter. The warlock learns to summon and bind one as a permanent minion.

angles.text: As a warlock, obtaining the Tome of the Cabal is a rite of passage toward mastery over felhunters, taking you beyond lesser servants into anti-magic demonology.
As an Alliance practitioner, you cross back from the frontier of Kalimdor to the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge to seek illicit dark texts.
As a dwarf, you see that not everyone buried in the Hall of Explorers digs up Titan artifacts; Krom Stoutarm privately compiles demonic lore.
